method: Opened and read primary editorial standards from AP and Reuters and the RFC Editor's timestamp specification through web browsing. These sources inform workflow, not a claim that any current news was retrieved.
scope: Source attribution, correction transparency, selective quotation, and known UTC offsets. No live story, breaking-news feed, subscription service, or current platform quota was verified.

sources.title: The Associated Press — Telling the Story
reviewedFacts: AP calls for attribution to original sources and vetting of information taken from the internet.
AP distinguishes brief credited use of others' material from retransmitting full stories and calls for clear correction labels.
AP stresses quotations in context and faithful translation.

sources.title: Reuters Journalistic Standards
reviewedFacts: Reuters prioritizes accuracy over speed, transparent correction, named and properly attributed sourcing, and cross-checking where possible.
Reuters explicitly cautions against describing a single source as plural sources.

sources.title: RFC 3339 — Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps
reviewedFacts: A numeric local offset is local time minus UTC, enabling explicit cross-offset conversion.
Unqualified local time is ambiguous across locations; the brief preserves unknown offsets instead of inventing them.

implementationInferences: A repost of one article is a distribution copy, not independent corroboration of its claim.
For a retrospective cutoff, retrieval may occur later; later corrections should be presented separately rather than backdated into what was publicly known at cutoff.
A user-provided URL or screenshot is not proof that the original page was opened in the current task.
notVerified: Any current news event or today's complete coverage
Any live source subscription, monitor, alert or delivery
Entitlement to reproduce any paywalled article
